answer: In this PoA model, reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so influence requires sustained honest service rather than a brief activity burst. A freshly spawned sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming endorsements; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot manufacture support within a hollow cluster. Thus it cannot pass consensus, despite any fable of instant trust, and remains marginal on the network horizon.
